d: Jharkhand men kishor vivah aur kam umr men matritv (Teenage Pregnancy) ki samasya kam hone ke bajay aur ganbhir hoti ja rahi hai. neshnal phaimili helth sarve-6 (NFHS-6) ke taja aankron ke anusar, rajy men kishor umr men garbhavastha ki dar 9.8% se barhkar 11.7% ho gaee hai. neshnal phaimili helth sarve ki yah riport is sandarbh men bhi behad chintajnak hai kyonki rajy ke shahri ilakon ki apeksha gramin ilakon men tinaej pregnensi ki tasvir aur bhi daravni hai
